notes: Partition verified: all 34 source ids and all 44 target ids occur exactly once across the 32 units; s028 is the sole unrepresented token and nothing is added.

s011–s013 (בִּמְאֹד מְאֹד → *exceeding*) is taken as one rule 30 fusion. That is right against rule 22, which rule 30 expressly confines to a repetition of the same element rather than the parts of an idiom, and the note names the alternative that would strand the repeated מְאֹד.

s023 takes the whole *of wresting of judgment* under rule 31, headed on the lexeme-bearing *wresting*; the ASV's italics on *of judgment* are evidence and not an infallible `added` label (rule 7), and the completion belongs to the substantive it completes.
s022 keeps only *full*: the English gaps the copula in the parallel line, so there is nothing further to place (rule 34). s015's *is full* is the verb's own rendering.
s032 heads on *not*, the negation word, as rule 50 requires; the ASV writes no dummy *there* here, and the unit is discontinuous from its clause-final position under rule 25.
